title: Happy bear cub
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <g>
    <!-- ears -->
    <circle cx='27' cy='28' r='11' fill='#8B5A2B'/>
    <circle cx='73' cy='28' r='11' fill='#8B5A2B'/>
    <circle cx='27' cy='28' r='6' fill='#D9996B'/>
    <circle cx='73' cy='28' r='6' fill='#D9996B'/>
    <!-- head -->
    <circle cx='50' cy='52' r='30' fill='#A0662F'/>
    <!-- muzzle -->
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='63' rx='16' ry='12' fill='#E8C39E'/>
    <!-- eyes -->
    <circle cx='39' cy='47' r='4.5' fill='#3B2412'/>
    <circle cx='61' cy='47' r='4.5' fill='#3B2412'/>
    <circle cx='40.5' cy='45.5' r='1.5' fill='#FFF6E0'/>
    <circle cx='62.5' cy='45.5' r='1.5' fill='#FFF6E0'/>
    <!-- nose -->
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='59' rx='6' ry='4.5' fill='#3B2412'/>
    <ellipse cx='48.5' cy='57.5' rx='1.8' ry='1.2' fill='#FFF6E0'/>
    <!-- happy mouth -->
    <path d='M42 64 Q50 73 58 64' stroke='#5A3A1E' stroke-width='2.6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <!-- cheeks -->
    <circle cx='31' cy='58' r='4.5' fill='#F2A6A0' opacity='0.85'/>
    <circle cx='69' cy='58' r='4.5' fill='#F2A6A0' opacity='0.85'/>
    <!-- body -->
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='88' rx='22' ry='14' fill='#A0662F'/>
    <ellipse cx='50' cy='90' rx='12' ry='9' fill='#E8C39E'/>
  </g>
</svg>
